name: Wonderstructs
summary:
Wonderstructs is a Mixed Reality application that lets you build massive, intricate rolling ball sculptures right in your own home! Drag and drop conveyors, track pieces, bowls, funnels, and switches from a virtual palette into your physical environment. The parts automatically snap together, making it easy to put together complex tracks that span your entire room.

# Gallery Mode

In gallery mode, browse the built in sculptures or download sculptures others have made.
